poly-mpm user guide¶

poly-mpm is a small two-dimensional material point method solver for solid and viscous/granular flow, including polydisperse grain-size segregation. It uses NumPy particle arrays and a regular Cartesian grid with selectable linear or quadratic interpolation.

Start with Getting started, then use Create a simulation to create an input. The numerical reports explain what has been checked and what remains limited; the examples are research fixtures, not a catalogue of calibrated materials.
